clue.text: Information given by party training

parts.note: a do is an informal word for a party or celebration
PE is physical education, school exercise training

explanation.surface: Someone passes on facts picked up at a political party's training session.
explanation.definitionFit: Slang usage: the inside facts or low-down on something can be called the dope.

clue.text: A race supporting Diana's verbal onslaught

indicators.note: in a down clue, a piece supporting another sits beneath it, so these letters come after

parts.note: Di is the usual short form of the name Diana
a tribe is a race or people

explanation.surface: A rival contest backing Princess Diana leads to a furious tirade.
explanation.walkthrough: 'supporting' is a down-clue placing: A plus TRIBE goes below DI.
explanation.definitionFit: A bitter, forceful spoken or written attack on someone is a tirade of this kind.

clue.text: Column ending in landing stage

indicators.note: the word in tells us one piece sits within the other

parts.note: a pier is a landing stage for boats
last can mean final or ending, as an adjective

explanation.surface: A pillar stands at the far end of a jetty.
explanation.definitionFit: Architecture term: a rectangular column projecting only slightly from a wall.

clue.text: Band bringing in drinks for floor show?

indicators.note: a band bringing in something holds it inside, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: a stripe is a band of colour
teas are drinks

explanation.surface: A musical group carts in refreshments for a cabaret act.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Band' looks musical but is a stripe of colour.
explanation.definitionFit: An erotic cabaret act performed on a club floor is one example of such entertainment, hence the question mark.

clue.text: After little time, study walk

indicators.note: after places the second piece behind the first, so the study word follows

parts.note: T is the abbreviation for time
to read a subject is to study it at university

explanation.surface: Following a short break, the student goes for a stroll.
explanation.definitionFit: To step or pace along is a synonym for walking.

clue.text: The very same Italian turned up in Iceland, shivering

indicators.note: in tells us one piece sits inside the other
shivering means shaking about, so the letters of the place are mixed up
turned up in a down clue means written upwards, so read backwards

parts.note: It is the short form of Italian, as in gin and It

explanation.surface: A traveller from Italy shows up in Iceland, cold and shaking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turned up' reverses IT; it goes inside IDENCAL, made by 'shivering' from the country's letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Two things that are exactly alike in every respect are described as such.

clue.text: Steal diamonds, maybe, and set of clothes

parts.note: to trouser money is slang for pocketing it, stealing
diamonds is one example of a suit in a pack of cards

explanation.surface: A jewel thief nicks gems along with a whole wardrobe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'diamonds' suggests jewels but is a card suit.
explanation.definitionFit: A woman's outfit of jacket with matching trousers is a two-piece clothing set.

clue.text: Difference in years, for example, between a girl's first and a chap's last

indicators.note: between means set in the middle of the letters around it, so the example piece goes inside
first asks for only the opening letter of the girl's word
last asks for only the closing letter of the chap's word

explanation.surface: An age difference, say, sits between a young woman and an older man.
explanation.definitionFit: The difference in age between two people, often partners, is called this.

clue.text: Good opinion of eastern power heard

indicators.note: heard signals that the word is spoken, so we take its sound and not its spelling

parts.note: steam is a source of power, as in steam engines

explanation.surface: Someone is told about a high regard for an Eastern power.
explanation.definitionFit: High regard or respect for someone is a synonym for a good opinion of them.

clue.text: Genuinely not about to join forces

indicators.note: not here means without, so a piece is dropped

parts.note: really means genuinely or truly
re is a Latin preposition meaning about or concerning

explanation.surface: Someone is truly not on the point of teaming up.
explanation.definitionFit: To unite with another party for a common cause is a synonym for teaming up.

clue.text: Well-meaning little boy taking rodent into hospital department

parts.note: Ben is a short form of a boy's name, such as Benjamin

indicators.note: into puts the rodent inside the department

parts.note: ENT is the ear, nose and throat department of a hospital
a vole is a small rodent

explanation.surface: A small lad brings a pet mouse to the hospital clinic.
explanation.definitionFit: Kindly and wishing others well is a synonym for good-natured intent.

clue.text: Pretty young woman stood up friend

parts.note: rose is the past tense of rise, so stood up
bud is American slang for a friend, short for buddy

explanation.surface: An attractive girl is jilted by her pal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stood up' suggests being let down on a date, but means rose to one's feet.
explanation.definitionFit: A young, fresh-faced girl is traditionally likened to an unopened flower, hence this term.

clue.text: Detective's London address in song

definitions.meaning: Sherlock Holmes lived at 221B on this street in London
a 1978 hit song by Gerry Rafferty with a famous saxophone riff

explanation.surface: A sleuth's city home gets celebrated in music.
explanation.definitionFit: The same London street name is both Holmes's fictional home and Rafferty's hit title.

clue.text: The Parisian after opera, finds how a model may be

indicators.note: after puts the French word behind the opera

parts.note: Tosca is Puccini's opera
le is French for the, as spoken in Paris

explanation.surface: A Frenchman goes to the opera and discovers something about a fashion model.
explanation.walkthrough: 'model' suggests a catwalk, but here it is a scale model.
explanation.definitionFit: A miniature built in exact proportion to the real thing is made in this way.

clue.text: Street performer in holiday resort's beginning to eat rock?

indicators.note: to eat means to take something inside, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: a break is a short holiday

indicators.note: beginning asks for the first letter of the resort word

parts.note: to rock is to dance to rock music

explanation.surface: A busker at a seaside town is about to bite into a stick of rock.
explanation.walkthrough: Rock is also a British seaside sweet, a hard candy stick, which makes 'eat' feel natural; here it is the verb to dance.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone performing acrobatic hip-hop dance moves, typically on the street, is this kind of performer.

clue.text: In disorder, lay on spread on Arabian craft

indicators.note: in a down clue, on puts the first piece above the second
spread means spread about, so the letters are laid out anew

parts.note: a dhow is a traditional Arab sailing vessel

explanation.surface: A messy display of goods is laid out on an Arab boat.
explanation.definitionFit: Carelessly, without any order or method, is what this informal phrase means.

clue.text: Drug reduced — that could be a blow

parts.note: an upper is a stimulant drug
cut means reduced, as in prices cut

explanation.surface: A narcotic diluted for sale could be a setback to dealers.
explanation.definitionFit: A boxing punch thrown upward under the chin is one kind of punch.

clue.text: Check on what sounds like beloved forest dweller?

indicators.note: in a down clue, on places the first piece above the second

parts.note: to rein in is to check or restrain

indicators.note: signals that the word is taken by its sound, not its spelling

parts.note: dear means beloved

explanation.surface: A sweetheart living in the woods is being kept tabs on.
explanation.definitionFit: A caribou is one animal that lives in the northern woods, hence the question mark.

clue.text: Play, 'R.U.R.', Pole shot in colour

indicators.note: shot means ruined or wrecked, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A Polish actor is gunned down in a colourful staging of the Capek drama R.U.R.
explanation.walkthrough: R.U.R. is Karel Capek's 1920 play that introduced the word robot.
explanation.definitionFit: A deep, rich purplish shade traditionally worn by monarchs is this colour.

clue.text: Busybody's energy drink, second inside

definitions.note: read as busybody is, so a noun that is the subject of the sentence

parts.note: go means energy or vigour

indicators.note: inside puts the second's letter within the drink

parts.note: a sip is a small drink

explanation.surface: A meddler takes a sports drink with a second one tucked in.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who chatters about others' private affairs is a synonym for a meddler or nosy parker.

clue.text: British trapped in a lounge on fire

indicators.note: trapped in means held inside, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: to laze is to lounge around

explanation.surface: A Brit is stuck in a burning sitting room.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lounge' looks like a room but is the verb to loaf about.
explanation.definitionFit: Burning fiercely with flames is a synonym for alight.

clue.text: Said about piece going round

indicators.note: about means around, so the first piece wraps the second

parts.note: oral means spoken or said
a bit is a piece

explanation.surface: Word is that a fragment is circulating.
explanation.definitionFit: Relating to an orbit, travelling in a circle around a body, is what this adjective means.

clue.text: Glib talk by northern model

parts.note: patter is smooth, glib talk of a salesman

explanation.surface: A smooth-talking fashion model from the North.
explanation.definitionFit: A template or design to be copied is a synonym for a model.

clue.text: Student at college interrupting short nap

indicators.note: interrupting means breaking into, so one piece goes inside the other
short means cut, so the last letter is dropped

parts.note: nap is the raised pile on fabric such as velvet
up means in residence at university, as in up at Oxford

explanation.surface: A student at university cuts short a quick snooze.
explanation.walkthrough: 'nap' suggests sleep but is the pile of fabric; 'short' trims PILE to PIL.
explanation.definitionFit: A learner being taught at a school is a synonym for a student.

clue.text: Room with it on board flying saucers, perhaps

parts.note: space means room, as in room to move

indicators.note: with here means containing, so the ship's letters hold the trendy word

parts.note: on board means aboard a ship; SS stands for steamship, and a thing on board sits inside it
hip means trendy, and it can mean the trendy thing

explanation.surface: A cabin with a trendy fitting aboard alien craft.
explanation.walkthrough: 'it' means sex appeal or trendiness, giving HIP; being 'on board' places it within the steamship's letters.
explanation.definitionFit: UFOs are one supposed example of craft that travel beyond Earth's atmosphere.

clue.text: Spots knight in one

indicators.note: in places the knight's letter inside the other piece

parts.note: an ace is a one in cards
N is the chess notation for a knight

explanation.surface: A lone knight is noticed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Spots' reads as a verb but is plural pimples.
explanation.definitionFit: A skin condition producing pimples is spots in everyday British usage.

clue.text: Good-looking and in good health, more or less

parts.note: pretty means attractive, good-looking
well means healthy

explanation.surface: Someone is attractive and fit, give or take.
explanation.definitionFit: This phrase means almost or nearly, the sense of approximately.

clue.text: Briefly introduce celebrity

indicators.note: briefly means cut short, so the last letter is removed

parts.note: to start something is to begin or introduce it

explanation.surface: A quick introduction for a famous guest.
explanation.definitionFit: A famous person in show business is commonly called this.
